name: Arduino IDE & Selkies Workspace
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y pcmanfm && sudo mkdir -p /config/Downloads && sudo wget -q https://downloads.arduino.cc/arduino-ide/nightly/arduino-ide_nightly-latest_Linux_64bit.AppImage -O /config/Downloads/arduino-ide.AppImage && sudo chmod +x /config/Downloads/arduino-ide.AppImage && cd /config/Downloads && sudo ./arduino-ide.AppImage --appimage-extract
